{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Sheer silk blouse, tailored collar, soft drape, midnight blue (#0B1D32), fluid silk chiffon
High-waisted wool crepe trousers, straight leg, full length, charcoal grey (#36454F), dense worsted wool
Structured blazer, single-breasted lapels, cropped at hip, forest green (#228B22), fine tweed blend
Classic pointed-toe pumps, sharp heel, moderate height, oxblood red (#8A0303), smooth calfskin leather

This ensemble perfectly balances her desire for restraint and classic elegance with the specific demands of an evening theatre outing. The structured blazer adds a layer of polished sophistication suitable for the smart dress code, while the deep tones of the blouse and trousers create a timeless, understated look. The rich oxblood pumps provide a sophisticated pop of color that complements the autumn season without compromising on formality, ensuring she feels confident and refined as she enters the theatre."}
